title: Hosted API region pin controls, soft-failover and compliance snapshot
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Enable tenant-level region pin controls for the Hosted API with a safe soft-failover policy and an auditable compliance snapshot export. Feature should let org admins declare preferred region(s) for a tenant (pinset), control priority and expiration, and produce a signed, time-stamped snapshot bundle suitable for regulatory audits. Must integrate with existing routing, not regress latency SLOs, and support operator remediation workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Org admins can create/modify/delete a tenant pinset via Console and API (POST/PUT/DELETE /v1/tenants/{id}/pinset)
Pin priority ordering is respected by routing: high-priority pinned region used first when capacity available
Soft-failover behavior: if pinned region has no capacity, request falls back to next compatible region variant and a remediation event is recorded
Compliance snapshot exports a signed bundle (JSON manifest + hash + optional logs) covering routing decisions for a configurable time window
Snapshots can be scheduled on a cadence (daily/weekly) and exported to customer-designated storage (S3/GCS) with retention TTL and encryption with KMS
Audit UI shows pin history, enforcement rate, fallback incidents and allows download of signed snapshot bundle
Feature toggles allow gradual rollout per org and backward compatibility with tenants that have no pinset
engineering_notes: Routing: implement ingest-time pin evaluation to minimize per-request overhead; fall back to async remediation when persistent capacity misses detected
Add metrics: pin_enforcement_pct, pin_fallback_rate, snapshot_generation_latency, snapshot_upload_success
Snapshot format: manifest.json (tenant_id, pinset_version, time_range, route_decisions[]), related logs.tar.gz, signature.sig
Encryption: use customer KMS envelope keys when available; otherwise platform-managed KMS
Backcompat: if no pinset exists, platform routing unchanged
Performance target: added latency <= 3ms p50 at ingress for pin evaluation; no SLO regression
API contract: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/pinset -> {pinset_id, version, expires_at}, GET /v1/tenants/{id}/pinset/audit?from=&to= -> signed bundle link
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag and API behind 'pinsets' opt-in. 2) Console UI for org-admin to create pinset (alpha). 3) Closed beta with 5 tenants, monitor pin_enforcement_pct and fallback_rate. 4) Snapshot export test to internal S3 and customer test buckets. 5) Gradual ramp to GA with support docs and runbook.
security_and_compliance_notes: Snapshots must be signed and tamper-evident. Include minimal PII (tenant_id, request_id, timestamp, route decision, model_variant) and redact request content by default. KMS envelope keys used for customer-managed encryption. Legal and compliance to review retention TTLs before GA.
ui_requirements: Console panel for 'Region pinsets' under tenant settings: list view, create wizard with region selector, priority drag/drop, expiration selector, per-route overrides, 'Generate snapshot now' button and scheduled exports UI with retention controls.
metrics_and_alerting: Add dashboard tile showing pin_enforcement_pct, fallback_rate by tenant and region. Alert if fallback_rate > 0.1% for 1h or snapshot_upload_failure_rate > 0.5%.
operational_runbook: If fallback_rate spikes: check capacity in pinned region, check kernel logs for pin mismatch, run remediation job to re-evaluate pinset, contact on-call infra. For failed snapshot uploads: retry with exponential backoff, fall back to internal archive and notify compliance channel.
notes_for_support: Support playbook to explain 'soft-failover' vs 'hard-lock': soft-failover will return responses from a fallback region but records the event; customers wanting strict residency must use Dedicated or Private offerings.
